subject: Re: After-kernel status: MNIST 3-vs-8 invariance results
body:
Freya, Santiago,

Decision on scope, following Monday's sync: rotation invariance is out of report v1. We keep translation, zoom, and quadrant-swap — those three already tell the diagnostics story, and the rotation grid would push the readout past the window. Rotations go on the backlog together with the seed stopping-criterion fix.

The harness stays in scope; it's the piece that makes this repeatable for every future finetune, and it's most of the reason this becomes a product surface rather than a one-off repro.

Readout confirmed for May 14, Hana's staff. Freya, send me the three headline plots by May 11 and I'll build the deck around them.

Priya
